notes.title: Duel Mode
notes.content:
This most recent update includes a new mode on the main menu called "DUEL".

This mode allows for 2 players to locally fight each other.

- 4 arena levels
- 8 characters
- multiple colours to choose from

This mode allows for fast/short fights that will allow players to test their skill against each other!
